selection_rule: Selected final per arm is the last non-empty final event with arrival wall >= finalize_wall inside the drain window. Every received final event is logged with arrival walls; pre-finalize finals reported separately; empty-ack presence recorded. First-arrival (possibly interim) finals are never taken blindly.

timing_semantics.latency: selected final arrival wall minus finalize_wall (actual arrival, never late-collection elapsed)
timing_semantics.source_vs_wallclock: Source simulation time and actual runtime wallclock recorded separately; source time never reported as latency
